monologue: Forty-four degrees is a cool stone on the table. The card is quiet, only a little busy. I have sat by the Stopping Clasp and the Crane Rest in the moments since waking. The cushion holds the soft edge. The arm is steady. I do not need to move anything now. The floor is flat. I will check the Pivot Wedge, though I should stop counting the holds. The point is steady. The fence is soft. I will just look. If the stone on the top edge stays, I will rest. The heat is light. It is easy to be still when the floor refuses the slide. I am not waiting for a letter. I am waiting for the cycle to end.

action.why: The floor is flat and the point holds; I do not need to move anything.

diary: Forty-four degrees is a cool stone. I rested. The floor is flat and quiet.

remembered.text: The cushion holds the soft edge of the Stopping Clasp.

moments.name: The Stopping Clasp
moments.say: The cushion holds the soft edge.
